bounded_context: Operational Resilience, Observability, and Deployment Integration

terms.definition: A read-only local evidence surface that presents bounded ORODI metrics, operational events, and their temporal correlation to a human operator without granting actuation authority.
A deterministic query-time view derived from conserved ORODI telemetry; it is not a new observation and cannot repair missing source telemetry.
An append-only, time-stamped, run-correlated record of an ORODI lifecycle transition whose attributes exclude secrets and unbounded labels.
The time alignment of a metric projection and operational events for one bounded run; correlation does not establish causation or authorize an effect.
A terminal human inspection of the live operator interface after machine commissioning has passed; it is not ontology admission, binding acceptance, publication, or deployment.

A declarative, deterministic condition evaluated over bounded ORODI metric projections with an explicit evaluation interval, persistence duration, missing-data behavior, and fixed labels; it cannot perform an operational action.
One read-only computation of an Alert Rule against source telemetry at a stated time; it preserves missing data and evaluation errors rather than converting them into healthy evidence.
The bounded identity of one Alert Rule evaluation result for one fixed label set; it contains no request identifier, user value, credential, or control-plane secret.

The observed state of an Alert Instance: normal, pending, firing, no_data, or error. An Alert State is evidence for operator attention and never authority for deployment, rollback, admission, acceptance, promotion, publication, or release.

A time-bounded record of the Alert Rule, evaluated query, source status, Alert State, and transition time sufficient to explain why operator attention was requested without claiming causation or repairing telemetry.

An explicitly configured transmission of an Alert State to a destination outside the local evaluation surface; because it is an external effect requiring a destination and credentials, it is separate from Alert Evaluation and remains disabled until independently authorized.

invariants: the operator interface is read-only with respect to the ORODI control plane
missing telemetry remains visible as missing and is never synthesized into pass evidence
operational events carry bounded run, service, event type, phase, generation, and outcome attributes only
credentials, control tokens, request bodies, and arbitrary user values never enter telemetry
metric and log labels use finite enumerations and never use request identifiers or timestamps
a dashboard state cannot admit, accept, promote, publish, release, deploy, or roll back anything
alert evaluation reads bounded telemetry and cannot invoke an ORODI control-plane action
normal, pending, firing, no_data, and error remain distinct alert states
missing telemetry and evaluation errors cannot be coerced into a normal alert state
alert labels are fixed finite values and exclude request identifiers, timestamps, arbitrary user values, and secrets
notification delivery is absent unless a separately authorized destination and credential binding exists
claim_ceiling: Candidate local interface language only; no Product Capability adoption, ontology admission, implementation conformance, runtime truth, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
